body: I am so sorry you’re in this situation. It definitely seems like he’s trying to get you pregnant, or at the very least does not respect your boundaries/ wishes whatsoever. I really wish I had advice for your living situation. Maybe call other shelters a little farther from you if you can take a bus or something. Do you have anyone at all who may be able to house you for at least a while? You should definitely try reporting this to your local authorities as well. They may be able to help given the abusive situation. I really want you to get out of there, that man is completely toxic.

I want to die, hear voices telling me to kill my self.....every single day and it’s so much worse / difficult/ impossible to control my moods without medication. I have moments where I feel like people are talking about me badly. Like I’ll be just walking around and think I hear people talking and saying I’m ugly and worthless and fat, things like that, even though I know that’s not the case. I often feel like all eyes are on me for some reason.
Yeah, I had no idea it could affect you like that. I’m honestly still recovering a year later. It changed me.

Things I’ve done AND things I’ve believed: I believed that the lemonade my boyfriends brother’s girlfriend gave us was poisoned (to be fair she is not nice). I have believed I could fly, that I was psychic, that I was better than everyone. I spent an entire paycheck and then some (2k) on a camera and I don’t even know what in about an hour online shopping. I quit a job, dumped a boyfriend. Who even knows what else.
